sources.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors via official OSM API 0.6
sources.method: Fetched complete relation and all way/node members. Joined only matching endpoint node IDs into genuinely closed outer/inner loops; open, ambiguous or invalid loops fail. Projected to a local equirectangular east/north metre frame, unioned source outers, subtracted source inner islands, and intersected with the ±4000 m station rectangle using Shapely. No simplification, inferred joins or shoreline invention. Rectangle edges are clipping boundaries, not measured coastline.
sources.limits: Source-map completeness/accuracy is not certified. Water level, tides and photographs are not supplied. Coverage ends at the explicit clipping rectangle; it is not a global ocean mask.

failures.reason: No complete regional water multipolygon was acquired. Complementing only Penang Island within a 4km window would wrongly classify the nearby Butterworth mainland as water. Partial coastline/DEM data are not used to invent a water mask.

additionalSourceSnapshots.role: Acquired complete candidate; final Sydney water mask uses the more detailed Port Jackson relation15522136. The older Sydney Harbour relation note says some administrative boundaries are used for simplicity.
